name: GWL Imperial Championship
epitaph: Held by Vice-President and on-screen wrestler Johnny Dice through this collection's own holdings, retained against Killer Ken Wilson at the fed's own first pay-per-view.
notes: The title's own founding is recorded only as a tournament-in-progress (Wednesday Night WAR, 11 Apr 1997); its final round does not survive in this collection's own holdings.

name: GWL World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Changed hands at Mother's Day Massacre when Roadkill's Outsiders won by countout over the reigning Angels of Death.
notes: The Angels of Death's own prior reign predates this collection's earliest surviving card; no won-date recovered for it.
